description: One PR per bump, reviewed and merged by a human (no automerge). Keeps the tag@sha256 pins in docker-compose.yml and the commit-SHA pins of GitHub Actions fresh; bin/test_pinning.py stops regressions.

packageRules.description: Only the third-party infra images are digest-pinned (docs/adr/0001); renewvan/* images keep exact version tags.
Grafana stays on the supported 12.4 line until the 13.x move (due before 2027-05-24).

customManagers.description: npx pins in workflows, e.g. npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0
